title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.21053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). translated_title: 系统1智能体：一种本地、可靠且快速的智能体AI方法
translated_abstract: 智能体人工智能可以自动化分析敏感的临床数据，但当前的智能体依赖于大型语言模型（LLM）。云端LLM会暴露患者数据，而本地LLM会产生幻觉，工具调用中一个虚构的值会传播到后续的每一个步骤。在此，我们提出一种构建系统1智能体的方法：即无需生成文本即可调用工具的本地智能体。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式和请求转换为多项选择题，其选项来自请求和模式，然后由一个单次通过的决策模型回答这些问题。在对157个生物医学工具的1,952个请求中，最佳的系统1智能体在97.0%的请求中选择了正确的工具或正确地拒绝执行，显著领先于所有18种本地LLM智能体设置（最佳为95.2%）。系统1智能体在6,056个已声明的参数值中正确填写了97.0%。没有任何系统1调用包含虚构内容，而LLM调用中有5.5%-19.7%包含虚构内容。系统1智能体框架是……
tldr: 该论文提出“系统1智能体”方法，通过确定性编译器将工具模式和请求转化为多项选择题，再由单次决策模型作答，使本地智能体无需生成文本即可调用工具，在1,952个生物医学工具调用请求中达到97.0%的准确率，并完全消除了虚构内容（幻觉）问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "System 1 agents"—local agents that call tools through multiple-choice questions answered by a one-pass decision model without generating text—achieving 97.0% accuracy on 1,952 biomedical tool-call requests while completely eliminating hallucinated content.
